## TDD checklist
- [ ] Wrote the failing test first
- [ ] Ran it and confirmed it failed for the expected reason
- [ ] Implemented the minimal code to make it pass
- [ ] All tests green locally (`python -m pytest -v`)
- [ ] CI is green on this PR
- [ ] Changes are limited to this task's **Files** list (no scope creep)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
